Maple: syrupUSDC live on Balancer; receipt for USDC lent to qualified institutional borrowers

applicabilityBasis.summary: syrupUSDC is an ERC-4626/LP-style receipt for USDC deposited into Maple and lent to qualified institutional borrowers; it accrues variable yield from overcollateralized loans and is used as a composable DeFi collateral asset rather than as a fixed-value payment instrument.

references.label: GENIUS Act enacted text: payment stablecoin definition

genius.notes: GENIUS scope was assessed explicitly because syrupUSDC is a prominent dollar-denominated asset that can be confused with a payment stablecoin. Its yield-bearing lending-receipt and DeFi-collateral structure supports the conservative non-payment-token classification.
